text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I found two ticket numbers for Quarrendon Freight Lines in Moss's notes. I sent you the list in our DM:

1. **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (dated 5 Oct 2025). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025. Drivers at Dock Doors 14–18 in the Eau Claire yard weren't getting their bay-assignment texts from the gatehouse kiosk. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed the next morning's 04:00 shift got through fine.
2. **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet". Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 support for scanner firmware testing. The cheat sheet has no date, so I can't tell when this ticket was opened.

I read all six of Moss's notes in the shared files. Two other notes mention Quarrendon Freight Lines but give no ticket numbers: the 14 Sept 2025 pipeline digest and the 23 Mar 2026 renewal check-in. The tickets in Moss's Central team notes (#4409, #4412 and FR-882) belong to other accounts, so I left them out. I also left out Quarendon Freightways, a different company that isn't our customer.
